positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked on iOS Mobile Development using Swift and Objective-C for the Flex app.  
Architected large scale refactoring of iOS code base for new Country Launches.  
Led design discussions between Android and iOS teams to resolve parity differences

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Retrained YOLO, You Only Look Once, ML algorithm to identify cars in traffic images.
Created scripts to process various data sources using Apache Storm and Kafka.
Created a server to spout randomized JSON objects upon HTTP request.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Overlooked, edited, and re-tested technical reports related to Machine Learning, Fraud Detection, Machine Learning Algorithm Benchmark testing on Spark, and Markhov Chain generations. 
Studied C++ Template Metaprogramming for potential use in a C++ testing library.
Began working on a project attempting to identify crops from plane images.
